**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW)**

- **Issue:** Section 28.1 (¶p0103) picks Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted list and near the walk-away position — and it directly contradicts Section 28.2 (¶p0104), which already gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County.
- **No arbitration clause** exists in the agreement, so the only issue is the law/venue conflict.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** minimal replacement of only the jurisdiction words in 28.1 — New York law (excluding conflict-of-laws rules) with venue conformed to the New York County courts per 28.2 — reaching the preferred position while leaving the rest of the sentence and 28.2/28.3 intact.
